I named him Lubo.|quotestart=0|Kazuda Xiono, to Neeku Vozo|audio=Lubo-Bibo.flac|}} '''Lubo''' was a [[Castilon gorg]] that had [[Color|brown]] and green skin and light blue [[eye]]s and lived on the [[planet]]''[[Ultimate Star Wars, New Edition]]'' [[Castilon]]. In [[34 ABY]], the [[human]] [[Kazuda Xiono]] obtained the [[gorg]] aboard the planet's ''[[Colossus]]'' [[Trantor-class supertanker fuel depot||station]] and named him Lubo. Xiono intended to gift the gorg to his [[Kadas'sa'Nikto]] friend, [[Neeku Vozo]], as a pet in order to comfort the [[Nikto]] after Vozo had returned his previous pet, the juvenile [[rokkna]] [[Bibo]], to the pet's [[Bibo's mother|mother]]. Within [[Jarek Yeager's Repair Station]], Xiono presented an excited Lubo to Vozo, and the Nikto happily accepted the gorg. However, Vozo mistook the gorg as a [[Foodstuff|meal]] and promptly [[Diet|ate]] him. Vozo thanked Xiono and commented on Lubo's deliciousness. ==Behind the scenes== Lubo first appeared in "[[Bibo (episode)|Bibo]]," the twelfth episode of the [[Star Wars Resistance Season One|first season]] of the animated television series ''[[Star Wars Resistance]]'', which aired on [[January 13]], [[2019]].{{DisneyPress|wdtv=1|url=disneychannel/shows/star-wars-resistance/episodes|text=Star Wars Resistance}} ==Appearances== *{{Resistance|Bibo (episode)}} {{1st}} ==Sources== *{{SW|url=series/star-wars-resistance/bibo-episode-guide|text="Bibo" Episode Guide | Star Wars Resistance}} {{Imo}} ==Notes and references== {{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of Lubo}} {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |fr=Lubo |ka=ლუბო (გორგი) }} [[Category:Gorgs]] [[Category:Individuals of unspecified gender]] [[Category:Individuals with he/him pronouns]] [[Category:Named pets]]
